name: Emerald Dialer
blurb: Emerald Dialer is a lightweight dialer app.
description:
Emerald Dialer is a lightweight dialer app.
Features:
* T9 contacts search;
* Speed dial;
* 4 themes: light, dark, night, AMOLED.

Supported languages:
* English
* Chinese (Pinyin input method)
* German
* Greek
* Italian
* Polish
* Portuguese (Brazil)
* Russian
* Spanish
* Turkish
* Ukrainian

T9 support provided for more languages
